Vändåtta ("turn eight") is the Swedish version of Crazy Eights, from the Eights group of matching games. It is widely played in Sweden and is commonly played for points over multiple deals, with penalty scoring for cards left in hand. Rules information was contributed by Carl Svensson (casinointernet.se).
Standard 52-card pack; two decks shuffled together if more than five players.
7 each. Rest = draw pile. Top card starts play pile.

items.text: Same suit for multiple cards: When playing several cards at once the first must match the top discard by suit (not rank).
No Ace on Ace: After an Ace the next card must be an ordinary card of the same suit; Ace may not be played on Ace.
Lappen only for one card: Lappen call required only when you have one ordinary card; if your last cards are several of the same rank you may go out without warning.
